title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Academy spaces with documented academic, collaboration, recreation, or team uses.

cards.title: Nimitz Library
cards.subtitle: Academic spaces and services for the Naval Academy community
cards.notes: Start at the library when you need a change of working pace; its four floors include tables, carrels, lounge seating, standing tables, and computers.
cards.short_summary: A multi-floor campus base for individual work, group work, and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library provides spaces, services, and resources for the Naval Academy community, including a variety of study settings across four floors.
cards.access_notes: Library services are primarily for the Academy community; authorized researchers and other users have specified access circumstances.

cards.title: Nautilus Room
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library main floor
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule before settling in; when it is not needed for library instruction, use this classroom for individual or group study.
cards.short_summary: A library classroom that can double as a study setting between scheduled uses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nautilus Room is a Nimitz Library classroom available for individual or group study when it is not in use for another purpose.
cards.access_notes: Library classes, meetings, and events take priority; consult the schedule posted on or near the door.

cards.title: Nimitz Room 227
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library second floor
cards.notes: Use the room for a focused solo or small-group session when no library class or meeting has it scheduled; look for the nearby room schedule.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor library classroom used as an open lab outside instructional commitments.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz 227 serves as an open lab and is available for individual or group study when it is not in use for library instruction or other priority activity.
cards.access_notes: Library instruction has first priority; use depends on the room schedule.

cards.title: Nimitz Room 301
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library third floor
cards.notes: Reserve this eight-person room for a planned team session and use its whiteboard and screen to keep the work visible to everyone.
cards.short_summary: A reservable third-floor group room with presentation and whiteboard tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Room 301 is a reservable third-floor study room for eight people with a whiteboard, screen, and VHS/DVD player.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library's room-reservation system; reservations are intended for occasional use.

cards.title: Nimitz Room 302
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library third floor
cards.notes: Book this four-person room when a smaller group needs a contained workspace; bring material that benefits from its whiteboard or chalkboard.
cards.short_summary: A compact reservable room for small-group work on the library's third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Room 302 is a reservable third-floor study room for four people with a whiteboard, chalkboard, and white-noise machine.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library's room-reservation system; availability varies by time slot.

cards.title: Halsey Field House
cards.subtitle: Indoor athletics and physical-fitness facility
cards.notes: Use the facility only during its posted operating times and authorized activities; its documented amenities include courts, squash, weight training, and a climbing wall.
cards.short_summary: An indoor athletics building supporting several forms of physical activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Halsey Field House includes an indoor football practice facility, basketball courts, international squash courts, weight-training facilities, and a climbing wall.
cards.source_title: Athletics | The Blue and Gold Book | USNA
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to posted facility hours and Academy authorization; midshipmen have priority in athletic facilities.

cards.title: Lejeune Hall
cards.subtitle: Aquatics, wrestling, and conditioning facility
cards.notes: Plan an authorized workout around the facility schedule; Lejeune combines an Olympic-sized pool, diving facilities, wrestling space, and conditioning areas.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic building centered on aquatics, wrestling, and conditioning.
cards.evidence_claim: Lejeune Hall contains an Olympic-sized pool, diving platforms and tank, a wrestling arena, and personal conditioning areas.
cards.source_title: Athletics | The Blue and Gold Book | USNA
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to posted facility hours and Academy authorization; midshipmen have priority in athletic facilities.

cards.title: Macdonough Hall
cards.subtitle: Multi-sport physical education and athletics building
cards.notes: Coordinate activity with Academy access rules; this hall brings together gymnastics, boxing, volleyball, aquatics, racquet sports, basketball, and conditioning facilities.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use athletics building with a broad mix of documented activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Macdonough Hall has facilities for gymnastics, boxing, volleyball, swimming, water polo, racquetball, basketball, and personal conditioning.
cards.source_title: Athletics | The Blue and Gold Book | USNA
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to posted facility hours and Academy authorization; midshipmen have priority in athletic facilities.

cards.title: Wesley Brown Field House
cards.subtitle: Physical education, varsity athletics, club sports, and fitness
cards.notes: Look to the scheduled program or authorized club activity before entering; the building is designated for physical education, varsity athletics, club sports, and personal fitness.
cards.short_summary: A large Academy field house serving structured athletics and fitness programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wesley Brown Field House houses facilities for physical education, varsity athletics, club sports, and personal fitness.
cards.source_title: Athletics | The Blue and Gold Book | USNA
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to posted facility hours and Academy authorization; midshipmen have priority in athletic facilities.

cards.title: Hubbard Hall
cards.subtitle: Home of Navy crew and the Fisher Rowing Center
cards.notes: View this waterfront athletics landmark from authorized areas, or participate only through scheduled rowing activity; it houses the Academy's crew squads and rowing center.
cards.short_summary: A named home base for Academy crew programs on the waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Hubbard Hall is the home for Navy's crew squads and includes the Fisher Rowing Center.
cards.source_title: Athletics | The Blue and Gold Book | USNA
cards.access_notes: Participation and building access are subject to Academy authorization and scheduled program requirements.
